intro: Content digests detect changed payload bytes during storage or transfer. A batch report should identify the exact records that need repair.
task: Compare lowercase SHA-256 digests for byte payloads and return mismatched indices.
requirements: payloads is a sequence of bytes, each at most 10000 bytes; expected is an equally long sequence of exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Return indices whose SHA-256 hexdigest differs from expected. Invalid digest syntax is an error, not a mismatch.
Sequence inputs are Python lists or tuples of at most 1000 items. Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.title: Trace one record
hints.body: Validate format separately from comparing a computed digest.

hints.title: Handle the boundary
hints.body: Keep mismatch positions aligned with the original batch.

explanation: Content digests detect changed payload bytes during storage or transfer. A batch report should identify the exact records that need repair.
A plain hash checks consistency against the supplied digest; it does not authenticate an untrusted sender. Malformed digest text is a contract error rather than evidence of changed content.
